# RT (wave 5), CONSOLE A/B: the timed scripted match (nav/match60.txt) on the lab package (MSCN00001; vitaGL cdbba42-glb with the patches platform/vita/vitagl/0001 + 0003-rt).
# The lab build has the RT timers on by default (VitaPlan: MSC_VITA_RT_TIMERS=3, MSC_VGX_RTTIME=1, MSC_LAT=1). Read in log.txt:
#   [rt] every 300 presents: scenes/frame, depth MB loaded/stored/not moved, CPU of the scene changes, the draw that begins a scene, GPU busy / span / tail p50 p95
#   [lat] every 300 shown frames: pad->shown p50 p95 (the input delay) and its stages; [frame-timing] ... lat_n lat_p50_us lat_p95_us
#   [vgx] prof (PROF=3) all=, [vgx-vita] display: interval ... (pictures held 0/1/2/3/4+ vblanks), [vita] frame N: fps
# AUTO: RT1 + MSC_FPS=auto (60 where the scene holds it). [fps] lines say why it goes up or down; [rt] GPU busy shows whether the GPU fits 16.7 ms.
MSC_INPUT_SCRIPT=match60.txt
MSC_MAX_FRAMES=12000
MSC_WATCH=1
MSC_WATCH_EVERY=300
MSC_FRAME_TIMING=300
MSC_VITA_MEMSTATS=1
MSC_VGX_PROF=3
NP_DATA_DIR=ux0:data/mscharged/np-data
MSC_PLAN=C
MSC_VGX_RT=1
MSC_FPS=auto
MSC_FPS_LOG=1
MSC_LATE_WAIT=0
